Download SDMX Data from TUIK

Source: R/statistical-data.R
statistical_data.Rd

Download a TUIK SDMX dataset identified by dataflow_id.

Usage

statistical_data(
  dataflow_id,
  key = "ALL",
  start = NULL,
  end = NULL,
  detail = "full",
  dimension_at_observation = "TIME_PERIOD",
  lang = "en"
)

Arguments

dataflow_id

Character string. SDMX dataflow identifier from statistical_tables.

key

Character string. SDMX key path. Default "ALL".

start

Character string or NULL. Optional start period.

end

Character string or NULL. Optional end period.

detail

Character string. Default "full".

dimension_at_observation

Character string. Default "TIME_PERIOD".

lang

Character string. Language for human-readable label columns derived from SDMX metadata. Default "en". Use "tr" for Turkish labels.

Value

A tibble with trimmed character columns, invariant dimensions removed, and *_label columns added for coded dimensions when labels are available.

See also

statistical_tables to discover dataflow_id values, statistical_resources for the portal catalog

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Download all observations from a dataflow
statistical_data("TR,DF_ADNKS_T26,1.0")

# Download with period filter
statistical_data(
  "TR,DF_ADNKS_T26,1.0",
  start = "2020",
  end = "2023"
)

# Download with specific SDMX key path
statistical_data(
  "TR,DF_UHTI_COGRAFI,1.0",
  key = "TR....../ALL"
)

# Download Turkish labels for dimensions
statistical_data("TR,DF_ADNKS_T26,1.0", lang = "tr")
} # }
